summary.name: neatly
summary.one_liner: neatly is a free, open-source Mac app that uses Apple Intelligence on-device to give downloads, screenshots and photos meaningful file names.
use_cases: rename downloaded files with meaningless names
give photos descriptive names like IMG_4108.HEIC
rename scanned or research PDFs by content
clean up messy Downloads folder on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: neatly renames files that have meaningless names, such as doc_8f3a2c.pdf or IMG_4108.HEIC, based on their content. It reads files on the Mac using Apple's built-in AI (Apple Intelligence) and does not upload them. Names the user chose themselves are left untouched. Every change can be undone, and a History view lets the user restore any earlier name. Optional online checks exist only for update checks, looking up a research paper's title from its number, and naming a photo's location; each can be turned off in settings.
notable: Runs on-device with Apple Intelligence; files are never uploaded
Only renames files with meaningless names and supports undo via History
Open source (MIT, Swift) with Homebrew install option
caveats: Requires an Apple M1 or newer chip and macOS 26 or newer
Best naming results need Apple Intelligence turned on
